source: Cerroni et al. 2022, Journal of Systematic Palaeontology 20(1): 1-32, Fig. 15A: strict consensus of the phylogenetic analysis of abelisaurids including Skorpiovenator; rectangular, root left, tips right, node dots (node-based) and half-circles (stem-based) numbered 1-3 and keyed to clade names in the caption. Panel B (reduced consensus) is excluded. Image: census figure (1882x1829 px).

names_note: the paper's matrix taxa (census list). The specimen tips printed 'MPCN-PV-69', 'MNN-TIG6' and 'CCG-20011' take the matrix spellings 'MPCN PV 69', 'MNN tig6' and 'CCG 20011'
gold_note: Ceratosaurian strict consensus with a 35-branch basal polytomy (33 taxa plus two pairs). Internal labels from the numbered markers via the caption key: 1 Neotheropoda, 2 Averostra, 3 Ceratosauria (a stem marker, given to the node it leads into). 42 tips, 1 polytomies (35 children); 3 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
